blocks.summary: Live: Anthropic to hit stock market with 'eye-popping' growth and massive losses. The AI giant behind Claude has filed its plans to float on the share market. MP claims Melbourne property allowance despite attendance concerns. A Geelong-region state MP claims almost $60,000 in taxpayer-funded allowances for a second home in Melbourne, despite appearing to have missed 88 of a possible 127 Parliamentary sitting days. Sydney University hires Jacinda Ardern as lecturer and mentor. The former New Zealand prime minister has been appointed a professor of practice, with a focus on empathetic leadership, social cohesion and civic trust.
